boundary.npz/times_seconds.description: Sample times of the prescribed inlet-flow waveform within its period.

boundary.npz/inlet_flow_cm3_s.description: Prescribed inlet volumetric flow rate; positive into the vascular tree.

boundary.npz/outlet_nodes.description: Terminal graph nodes in the same order as the RCR parameter rows.

boundary.npz/rcr.description: Columns are proximal resistance Rp, compliance C, and distal resistance Rd.

boundary.npz/period_seconds.description: Cardiac period used to sample inlet forcing and define the 64-phase sequence.

boundary.npz/phase_offset_seconds.description: Time offset applied when sampling the periodic inlet waveform.

boundary.npz/viscosity_cgs.description: Dynamic viscosity in the boundary representation.

common_features.npz/node_common.description: Node static feature channels 0–11 in data/FEATURE_SPEC.md.

common_features.npz/edge_common.description: Edge static feature channels 0–12 in data/FEATURE_SPEC.md.

common_features.npz/global_common.description: Graph-wide static feature channels 0–8 in data/FEATURE_SPEC.md.

common_features.npz/node_common_time.units: scaled flow, time and dimensionless phase channels
common_features.npz/node_common_time.description: Eight prescribed-forcing channels, repeated at each node; data/FEATURE_SPEC.md gives their order.

graph.npz/radius_cm.description: Vessel radius at each graph node.

graph.npz/edge_index.description: Row 0 contains source nodes and row 1 target nodes; edges point from inlet toward outlets.

graph.npz/edge_length_cm.description: Physical segment length for each directed edge.

graph.npz/inlet_mask.description: True at the inlet/root graph node.

graph.npz/outlet_mask.description: True at terminal outlet graph nodes.

graph.npz/case_feature_names.description: Names describing graph-level boundary summaries: outlet count, resistance and compliance statistics. The neural tensor channel order is specified separately in data/FEATURE_SPEC.md.

labels.npz/steps.description: CFD output step for each of the 64 section-label frames.

labels.npz/pressure_node.description: CFD cross-sectional mean pressure at node sampling planes. Divide by 1333.22 for mmHg.

labels.npz/flow_edge_cm3_s.description: CFD cross-sectional volumetric flow along each directed edge normal.

labels.npz/node_area_cm2.description: Area of the pressure-sampling section at each node.

labels.npz/edge_area_cm2.description: Area of the flow-sampling section for each edge.

labels.npz/node_label_mask.description: True identifies node-pressure sections included in supervised loss and scoring.

labels.npz/edge_label_mask.description: True identifies edge-flow sections included in supervised loss and scoring.

local_constraints.npz/local_edges.description: Edges with an input-derived local flow-consistency target.

local_constraints.npz/local_target_raw.description: Local target formed from prescribed inlet flow and the geometric observation offset.

local_constraints.npz/local_rms_limits.description: Stored per-section RMS comparison levels retained for historical reproducibility; not predictive inputs, local-loss targets, loss weights or public metric acceptance criteria.

observation_map.npz/boundary_offset_cm3_.description: Input-derived correction to transport flow; observation-compatible flow is transport flow minus this array.

observation_map.npz/inlet_chain.description: Edges on the inlet-connected unbranched chain used by the observation mapping.

observation_map.npz/inlet_contact_length.description: Geometric length of inlet-plane contact associated with each edge observation.

observation_map.npz/inlet_contact_checke.description: Identifies edges where inlet-plane contact was evaluated.

observation_map.npz/inlet_offset_active.description: Identifies edges whose observation mapping applies an inlet-related offset.

observation_map.npz/plane_global_crossin.description: Number of surface crossings used to describe each sampling plane.

observation_map.npz/BCT_replay_max_cm3_s.description: Maximum inlet-flux reconstruction difference in the prescribed BCT mapping.

phases.npz/times_seconds.description: Absolute CFD output times, measured from the simulation time origin.

phases.npz/relative_times_seconds.description: Output times relative to the first frame in the selected window.

phases.npz/steps.description: Same ordered CFD output steps as labels.npz/steps.

phases.npz/phase_fraction.description: Sample ordinal divided by 64; absolute timing is given by times_seconds.

physics.npz/times_seconds.description: RI–RCR sampling times including the additional frame one period after the first.

physics.npz/states.units: first M-1: cm^3/s; last M: mmHg
physics.npz/states.description: Free terminal-flow coordinates followed by outlet capacitor-pressure states.

physics.npz/pressure_mmHg.description: RI–RCR node pressure outputs on the 65-frame physical sampling sequence.

physics.npz/flow_cm3_s.description: RI–RCR transport flow before subtraction of the observation offset.

section_geometry.npz/physical_edge_index.description: Directed physical edges, ordered as graph.npz/edge_index.

section_geometry.npz/incidence.description: Node-edge incidence with -1 at an edge source and +1 at its target.

section_geometry.npz/interior_nodes.description: Nodes having both incoming and outgoing physical edges.

section_geometry.npz/terminal_sum_map.description: Maps terminal outlet flows to transport flow on each physical edge.

section_geometry.npz/message_edge_index.description: Physical edges followed by their reversed directions for bidirectional graph operations.

section_geometry.npz/message_physical_ed.description: Physical-edge index associated with each bidirectional edge entry.

section_geometry.npz/message_direction.description: +1 for physical direction and -1 for the reversed edge entry.

section_geometry.npz/pressure_center_cm.description: Pressure-sampling plane centers at the graph nodes.

section_geometry.npz/pressure_normal_uni.description: Pressure-plane unit normals where pressure_plane_defined is True; zero otherwise.

section_geometry.npz/pressure_plane_defi.description: Identifies nodes with a constructed pressure sampling-plane normal.

section_geometry.npz/flow_center_cm.description: Flow-sampling plane centers at edge midpoints.

section_geometry.npz/flow_normal_unit.description: Flow-plane unit normals directed from source node toward target node.

inflow_source.description: The inlet flow waveform is obtained by surface integration of the prescribed inlet velocity boundary condition.

source_index_fields.source_group: Internal provenance-group identifier for the unchanged five-fold assignment.
source_index_fields.source_model_sha256: SHA256 of the original VMR source-model file.
source_index_fields.source_archive_name: Official VMR project name, identical to source_archive_id in this collection.
source_index_fields.source_url: Stanford Digital Repository page for the VMR archive.
